projects.title: Cypress Robot Kit
projects.description:
Senior Design Project
Winner of The Michelle and Alex Bratton Senior Design Instructor’s Award (1st Place, Fall 2017)

Project Sponsored by Cypress Semiconductors
The goal was to create a Robot Kit for hobbyists to be able to explore the capabilities of Cypress's PSoC chip. To accomplish this, we designed:
- Custom PCB "shield" for PSoC 4 BLE with power regulators (buck converters) and h-bridges for motor control
- Firmware for PSoC 4, with ultrasonic, IR sensors, and BLE control
- Android Application for BLE connection to robot that can monitor sensors, change robot mode, and control the robot
- Electronic and kit components were selected to keep cost under $150, and surface mount components were selected be large enough to solder by hand in order to keep the kit accessible to hobbyists.

projects.title: Knock Localization on Android
projects.description: Android signal processing application that uses cross correlation, microphones and accelerometer to detect knocks on surfaces near a smartphone, and to identify what side the user knocked on.

organizations.name: Vietnamese Student Association
organizations.description:
Secretary: August 2016-Present
- Responsible for weekly newsletters and board meetings
- Work with public relations to promote VSA events and keep general members informed
- Restructured internal VSA communication to be modeled after small companies, focusing on keeping board members up-to-date on other positions' activities in order to increase collaboration
- Increased efficiency of board meetings and reduced length

Cultural Show Director: August 2015-February 2016
- Organized Vietnamese Cultural Night
- Managed ~60 students to put on free cultural performance for University of Illinois students, Urbana-Champaign Vietnamese community members, and parents
- Included three cultural dances, one hip-hop dance, two live musical performances, and a play
- Created framework for future shows that allowed for a larger production than previous years
- Audience count over 2x as previous years - audience of 400.
- Winner of UVSA-Midwest Best Cultural Performance for 2016.
